key.name: flash-on-waiting-agents
key.description: Briefly expand the notch of Visor when a T3 Code agent starts waiting for an approval.

key.name: servers
key.description: The origins of the T3 Code servers the module is paired with, such as http://127.0.0.1:3773 for this machine or http://100.87.29.32:3773 for another one in the tailnet. Their sessions are shown together. Each access token is in the keyring and is sent to its own server only. Empty: not paired, no sessions are shown.

key.name: server-url
key.description: The address of the one server of older versions. Carried over into "servers" once and emptied then.

key.name: token-origin
key.summary: Origin of the T3 Code access token (before version 0.2)
key.description: The server older versions were paired with. Carried over into "servers" once and emptied then.

key.name: token-serial
key.summary: Changes of the T3 Code access token
key.description: Counted up by the settings window whenever it stored or removed an access token in the keyring, so that the module reads it again.
